narrative: First token for Mosh, a protocol built on Pons that uses locked bundles and AI market-making agents; potentially important evidence that speculation is becoming composable above the Pons launchpad layer.
rejection_reasons: Go+ currently reports one unresolved security issue.
Only about $401K of quoted pool liquidity supports a roughly $19.6M market cap after an extreme first-day move; executability/liquidity-removal risk is too high for qualification.
The token is less than one day old, so holder and price persistence are not established.
Very high trade/trader counts are explicitly discounted in this ecosystem because commercial volume bots can generate volume and fresh-wallet breadth.
why_preserve: BUN is a useful prospective false-positive test: it has a powerful Robinhood/Pons-native composability narrative and extreme activity, but the framework rejects it before knowing the forward outcome because a structural gate fails.
